Oklahoma Upsets No. 1 Texas in College Football Rivalry

Oklahoma defeated No. 1 Texas in a college football game, with Tate Sandell kicking a game-ending 47-yard field goal. Arch Manning of Texas acknowledged crucial mistakes made by his team, stating, 'I think we beat ourselves.' The loss for Texas occurred in their rivalry game against Oklahoma.
